profile: Henry Schein distributes health care products and services primarily to dental and medical practitioners and alternate care sites. Its offerings include branded and corporate-brand merchandise, equipment, technical services, financial and consulting services, continuing education, and practice management software and e-services. The company also manufactures and sells dental implants, biomaterials, endodontic, orthodontic and orthopedic products for dental practices, laboratories, physician practices and other health care providers.
